workshoptitle: Migrate AlmaLinux to Oracle Linux on OCI

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Review the AlmaLinux migration path, OCI configuration, and checkpoints.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Create the OCI Environment and AlmaLinux Instance
tutorials.description: Use the OCI Console to create a compartment, VCN, and AlmaLinux 9.8 E5.Flex VM with 1 OCPU and 12 GB RAM.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Create and Baseline the Workload
tutorials.description: Create an Apache test workload and capture the AlmaLinux baseline.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Assess Readiness and Test Recovery
tutorials.description: Verify the pinned script, run its dry run, and rehearse recovery from a boot-volume backup.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Migrate to Oracle Linux
tutorials.description: Convert AlmaLinux 9.8 to Oracle Linux 9.8 and reboot into RHCK.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Manage and Patch Oracle Linux
tutorials.description: Review Oracle Linux repositories, apply updates, and check the workload.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Apply Live Updates with Oracle Ksplice
tutorials.description: Preview and apply available RHCK live updates without rebooting.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Validate and Clean Up
tutorials.description: Compare evidence, review AlmaLinux package exceptions, and remove disposable lab resources.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Find assistance with workshop access and execution.
